story.body: You kept your hand on your face. Master Thwaite sent the other eight orders to Monday. Sir John Spencer answered the litany and did not look at you. You did not answer him.

story.body: You were judged at the board and given a day. You refused the door and ate the sops. You named Saturday's share and would have given half of it to chew. You did not pay the barber, and you did not divide the share into a price.
